sources.title: qwen2.5-coder:32b
sources.snippet: Code Reasoning: Code reasoning refers to the model's ability to learn the process of code execution and accurately predict the model's inputs and outputs. The recently released Qwen2.5 Coder 7B Instruct has already shown impressive performance in code reasoning, and this 32B model takes it a step further.

sources.title: Qwen2.5-Coder Technical Report - arXiv.org
sources.snippet: Our Qwen2.5-Coder-32B-Instruct model achieves comparable performance to the DS-Coder-V2-Instruct model with only 32 billion parameters, bringing it very close to the performance of several closed-source APIs.

sources.title: [2409.12186] Qwen2.5-Coder Technical Report - arXiv.org
sources.snippet: As a code-specific model, Qwen2.5-Coder is built upon the Qwen2.5 architecture and continues pretrained on a vast corpus of over 5.5 trillion tokens.
